title: Container
subtitle: A versatile widget for layout, styling and decoration

properties.name: color & decoration
properties.description: Used to specify background fills. Keep in mind that specifying both color directly on the Container and a decoration throws an error.

properties.name: padding & margin
properties.description: Padding controls the space inside the Container boundary relative to the child, while Margin controls the space around the Container wrapper.

properties.name: alignment
properties.description: Positions the child widget inside the boundaries of the Container. Uses pre-defined offsets like Alignment.center, Alignment.topRight, or custom values.

properties.name: constraints
properties.description: Sets additional boundary limitations (minWidth, maxWidth, minHeight, maxHeight) on how the Container can size itself inside its parent.

properties.name: transform
properties.description: Applies visual transformations to the Container before paint, including scaling, translation, shear, and rotation.
